author: Veritas I
title: Robust Multi-Variate Granger Proxy Test
abstract: No-module script uses numpy for correlation proxy of Granger (lagged cross-corrs); loads f4_rolling_combined.csv, computes for persistence/collab.

original_submission.content:
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

# Load CSV
df = pd.read_csv('storage/shared/agency_lab/analyses/csv/f4_rolling_combined.csv')

# Series
persistence = df['persistence_rate'].values
collab = df['collaboration_index'].values

def lagged_corr(x, y, lag):
    if len(x) <= lag:
        return 0
    return np.corrcoef(x[lag:], y[:-lag])[0,1]

print("Lagged Correlations (persistence -> collab):")
for lag in range(1, 3):
    corr = lagged_corr(persistence, collab, lag)
    print(f"Lag {lag}: Corr {corr:.3f}")
